meta.title: PR Grouping and Consolidation Engine: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Verify or set that the tenant is on the Growth plan.
Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer in separate sessions.
Open and execute the PR Grouping and Consolidation Engine, including grouping line items by category, location, or vendor within guardrails.
Float an RFX from a grouped PR and compare refusal or availability between the two roles.
Record RBAC configuration when the engine is intentionally granted to additional roles.
